sentence: Builds a certificate program for semiconductor technicians and a web portal used to compare technician education programs with a competency model.
Builds devices from thin films of a crystal called barium titanate on silicon that shape and steer light much faster than liquid crystal versions.
Tries to find out how language can guide the training of machine learning models so they better understand visual scenes and household chores.
Develops quantum computing and quantum networking tools for power system state estimation, aiming for faster responses to changes and data communication with high confidentiality.
Uses X-ray scattering to measure how electrons are spread out and how they influence each other in excited-state molecules.
Builds cybersecurity courses and degree programs that draw on many fields, such as computer science, electrical engineering, psychology and the humanities.
Develops trustworthy machine learning methods that explain their predictions, aiming at early diagnosis of neurodegenerative diseases.
Studies what makes environmental DNA in streams break down, get deposited in streambed sediments or move further downstream.
Builds a one-year pathway of college credits in cybersecurity fundamentals, covering network security, risk management and digital forensics.
Develops polymeric resin beads that selectively capture target molecules from complex mixtures for purification of biological molecules.
Uses machine learning to design proteins that recognize a chosen target protein in a cell and cleave it at an internal site.
Tests whether germicidal ultraviolet light sent through nano fibers can stop biofilms from growing in water systems, both on Earth and in space.
Studies how small autonomous robots can join visual perception and action to make fast decisions and navigate complex environments.
Tests how factors such as temperature, water availability and wildfire affect the quantity and quality of seeds made by trees in boreal forests.
Studies why some monkeyflower species pollinate themselves and what has driven the origin and persistence of self-fertilization, using genetic sequencing data.
Builds an imaging spectrometer that detects gas falling onto galaxies to find out how this gas fuels galaxy growth.
Acquires an instrument that joins liquid chromatography with a mass spectrometer for organic separation and identification.
